No #HMPV Cases in Telangana, Health Dept Assures

Telangana Health Dept confirms no Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV) cases in the state. Advises precautions: cover coughs, wash hands, avoid crowds, and stay home if sick. Monitoring situation closely. No cause for alarm. #HealthUpdate https://t.co/OhjV2eajiQ
